node.statement: Node 1.1 defines e_rc=min(e_co,e_cmp), fixes arbitrary data satisfying e=delta+epsilon<=e_rc, and sets C_rc=C_co; hence e<=e_co. Node 1.4.1.1 gives, in the single square amplification M_{n+1} tensor A, R_Y in S_{I_{n+1} tensor Q,I_{n+1} tensor P} and C_X in S_{I_{n+1} tensor P,I_{n+1} tensor Q}, so the pair is compatible. Applying the registered af-validated lem-compcb-rectangular-product-CONTRACT with m=n+1, A_factor=R_Y, B_factor=C_X, P_m=I_{n+1} tensor Q, Q_m=I_{n+1} tensor P, and R_m=I_{n+1} tensor Q therefore yields ||R_Y dot C_X-R_Y C_X||<=C_co*e*||R_Y||*||C_X||. This is the claim of node 1.4.1 (and C_co=C_rc by node 1.1).
